mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.family_id = #{familyId} AND r.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT a.auth_code FROM sys_auth a JOIN sys_role_auth ra ON ra.auth_id = a.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ra.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.family_id = #{familyId}
